opportunity.title: Scalable GEOINT Architecture IT Contractor Manpower Equivalent (CME) Support
opportunity.description: Request for Proposal W50NH9-27-R-A006 for Scalable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT) Architecture IT Contractor Manpower Equivalent support for U.S. Army Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM). Proposals due Nov 13, 2026 with a proposal validity of at least 240 days. Period of performance: one 30-day transition-in, a 12-month base, four 12-month options and one six-month option. Estimated award date Jan 11, 2027. Primarily time and materials, evaluated on a best value trade-off basis.

profile.pastPerformance: Four years in the SBA 8(a) program. Two DoD sub-contracts for network monitoring (about $1.2M each) and one Air Force base-level help desk prime task order (about $900K).
profile.capacityNotes: Fourteen staff, eight with active Secret clearances. Facility clearance in progress, not yet granted. FedRAMP not started.
verification: NAICS codes confirmed against USAspending reference (api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/references/naics) on 2026-10-16.
Set-asides follow SBA definitions: SBA = small business, 8A = 8(a) Business Development, HUBZONE, WOSB/EDWOSB, SDVOSB.

rationale.point: The opportunity is for scalable GEOINT architecture IT contractor manpower equivalent support (Claim #1), which likely requires specialized GEOINT expertise and significant scale beyond the company's past performance of network monitoring sub-contracts and a help desk prime task order.

The anticipated time-and-materials contract type (Claim #2) does not mitigate the size and complexity mismatch; the company's 14-person staff with only 8 Secret clearances and no facility clearance or FedRAMP readiness is insufficient for a scalable architecture effort.

risks: Full and open competition (set-aside NONE) against large businesses with deep GEOINT experience
Median top award value of $152M indicates typical contract scale far exceeds company's largest prime ($900K)
No facility clearance or FedRAMP authorization limits ability to handle classified or high-value work
Past performance lacks GEOINT architecture or scalable manpower equivalent support relevance
nextSteps: Target small-business set-aside opportunities in NAICS 541519 matching network monitoring and help desk experience
Advance facility clearance and FedRAMP processes to expand eligibility
Consider teaming as a subcontractor on larger GEOINT efforts to build relevant past performance
Monitor DoD 8(a) sole-source or set-aside opportunities aligned with current capacity
